name: Agent Warden
author: VanillaGreen
description: A shield in the bar that shows whether the agent warden vsys ships keeps your AI agents within their memory and task limits, and a small panel with what needs a look and a link that opens vsys. It reads the warden's status and never changes an agent itself.

showCount.label: Show a count
showCount.description: Show beside the shield how many agents run, or how many things need a look

hideWhenIdle.label: Hide when idle
hideWhenIdle.description: Hide the shield while no agent runs and nothing needs a look

requirements.purpose: The agent dashboard that ships the warden
Starts the warden's timer again from the panel when it has stopped checking

warden.label: Warden
warden.hint: Keeps AI agents within their memory and task limits. Run this once to set it up.

vsys.label: vsys
vsys.hint: The agent dashboard that ships the warden
